description: Tests the coordinator/gate's response to an already-normalized provider_diagnostic reporting that argument evidence arrived after this call's own terminal event - NOT whether an adapter can derive that conclusion from raw provider wire data. The diagnostic is this fixture's input, not something the implementation is asked to infer: recognizing a late fragment from raw wire evidence is a provider-adapter concern outside the normalized-gate profile (see docs/CONFORMANCE.md's 'Provider-adapter conformance' section). Once such a diagnostic is present in the normalized stream, the gate must fail the call closed.

provenance.note: The diagnostic code modeled here (E_TOOL_ARGUMENTS_AFTER_END) is real and currently emitted by every provider adapter in this package from raw wire evidence - but that emission is out of scope for this fixture, which only tests the gate's reaction once the diagnostic already exists in the normalized stream. A bare late tool_call_arguments_delta with no such diagnostic present is a different, weaker case: it resolves retry/stream_incomplete via general trailing-data handling, not reject.

events.message: Argument evidence arrived after this call's own terminal event.
